title.en: Salesforce introduces seven job-specific Agentforce agents
title.zhHans: Salesforce 推出七款面向具体工作的 Agentforce 智能体

searchSummary.en: Salesforce announced seven named Agentforce agents for service, IT and HR, shopping, sales, supply chain, lead generation, and customer experience; six are GA and Hunter remains in pilot.
searchSummary.zhHans: Salesforce 发布七款具名 Agentforce 智能体，覆盖服务、IT 与 HR、购物、销售、供应链、线索生成和客户体验；其中六款已 GA，Hunter 仍处于试点。

summary.en: On September 11, Salesforce introduced seven named Agentforce agents: Casey, Paige, Carter, Hunter, Marshall, Piper, and Fin. Salesforce lists six as generally available and Hunter as a pilot with general availability planned for November 2026. The portfolio is built around job-specific workflows, while a new long-horizon runtime is designed to keep plans moving across days and weeks.
summary.zhHans: 9 月 11 日，Salesforce 发布七款具名 Agentforce 智能体：Casey、Paige、Carter、Hunter、Marshall、Piper 和 Fin。Salesforce 称其中六款已正式可用，Hunter 目前为试点，计划于 2026 年 11 月正式可用。该产品组合围绕具体岗位工作流构建，新的长时运行时则用于让计划跨越数天或数周持续推进。

narrative.en: The announcement packages agents by business role rather than by a general assistant's open-ended capability. Casey handles service, Paige handles IT and HR, Carter handles shopping, Hunter works on outbound sales, Marshall coordinates supply-chain processes, Piper qualifies inbound leads, and Fin handles customer-experience workflows. Salesforce says the agents operate within customer permissions and business rules and reports early customer percentages; those figures are vendor-reported. Hunter is the first agent on the long-horizon runtime and remains a pilot, so the release does not establish broad autonomous workforce replacement.
narrative.zhHans: 这次发布按业务岗位而非通用助手的开放能力来打包智能体。Casey 处理客户服务，Paige 处理 IT 和 HR，Carter 处理购物，Hunter 负责外呼销售，Marshall 协调供应链流程，Piper 筛选流入线索，Fin 处理客户体验工作流。Salesforce 称这些智能体遵循客户权限和业务规则，并报告了早期客户比例；这些数字来自厂商。Hunter 是首个运行在长时运行时上的智能体，且仍处于试点，因此本次发布不能证明广泛的自主劳动力替代。

description.en: Extends packaged enterprise agents from single interactions toward job-specific plans that can persist across days and weeks, subject to customer controls.
description.zhHans: 将企业智能体从单次交互扩展到可跨越数天或数周持续的具体岗位计划，但仍受客户控制约束。

description.en: Frames a growing set of CRM and back-office tasks as deployable agent roles, increasing pressure to define which decisions remain with employees and which can run autonomously.
description.zhHans: 将更多 CRM 和后台任务定义为可部署的智能体岗位，增加了界定哪些决策由员工保留、哪些可自主运行的压力。

text.en: Salesforce announced seven named Agentforce agents on September 11; it lists Casey, Paige, Carter, Marshall, Piper, and Fin as generally available and Hunter as a pilot with planned November 2026 GA.
text.zhHans: Salesforce 于 9 月 11 日发布七款具名 Agentforce 智能体；公司将 Casey、Paige、Carter、Marshall、Piper 和 Fin 列为已正式可用，将 Hunter 列为试点并计划于 2026 年 11 月 GA。

text.en: The portfolio uses job-specific packaging and a long-horizon runtime intended to preserve goals, memory, and execution across longer sales, service, and operations workflows.
text.zhHans: 该产品组合采用具体岗位打包方式，并使用旨在让目标、记忆和执行跨越更长销售、服务和运营工作流的长时运行时。

text.en: Salesforce's customer percentages are early vendor-reported results; Hunter's long-horizon capability remains a pilot and the release does not establish workforce replacement.
text.zhHans: Salesforce 的客户比例是厂商报告的早期结果；Hunter 的长时能力仍处于试点，发布内容也不能证明劳动力替代。

editorial.reviewNotes: L1 enterprise-agent product node. GA, pilot, and planned-GA states are separated; customer outcome figures remain vendor-reported.
